يستكثر (form X)
# يَسْتَكْثِرُ (yastakṯiru) /jas.tak.θi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# يُسْتَكْثَرُ (yustakṯaru) /jus.tak.θa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# يَسْتَكْثِرَ (yastakṯira) /jas.tak.θi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْثَر
